chunks.l2:
[tal-a32-v00] Now I speak here the procedure of mudrās praised in guru-scripture song.

[tal-a32-v01] Mudrā, reflection-natured, is said in the venerable Devyāyāmala, by hearing bimbodaya, from discernment of two predicates.

[tal-a32-v10] There with full form I describe Khecarī alone; having bound lotus-seat, yogī should cast navel-ākāśa-īśvara.

[tal-a32-v02] Emergence from bimba of whom thus said reflection-ness; of bimba of whom emergence thus said instrumentality thereof.

[tal-a32-v03] Delight, called own-nature-gain, through body-gate of selves bestows at night; which by that mudrā in śāstras described.

[tal-a32-v04] There principal venerable Khecarī, deity-natured, known in undivided state; in divided state Triśūlinī.

[tal-a32-v05] Karaṅkiṇī, Krodhanā, and Bhairavī, Lelihānikā, Mahāpretā, Yogamudrā, Jvālinī, Kṣobhiṇī, Dhruvā.

[tal-a32-v06] Thus many varieties this, venerable Khecarī alone is sung; others her limb-born but, Padmā and the rest, in Mālinī doctrine.

[tal-a32-v07] Of them, by abundance and non-principality, not here description; venerable Khecarī-absorbed, whatever place should resort.

[tal-a32-v08] For goddess presence that would be enough; what with vain pomp; in desired rite they and would be principal of someone ever.

[tal-a32-v09] Mudrā fourfold by division of body, hand, speech, mind.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C32 atha śrītantrāloke dvātriṃśamāhnikam atha kathaye mudrāṇāṃ gurvāgamagītamatra vidhim / 0b mudrā ca pratibimbātmā śrīmaddevyākhyayāmale / uktā bimbodayaśrutyā vācyadvayavivecanāt bimbātsamudayo yasyā ityuktā pratibimbatā / vimbasya yasyā udaya ityuktā tadupāyatā mudaṃ svarūpalābhākhyaṃ dehadvāreṇa cātmanām / rātyarpayati yattena mudrā śāstreṣu varṇitā tatra pradhānabhūtā śrīkhecarī devatātmikā / niṣkalatvena vikhyātā sākalyena triśūlinī karaṅkiṇī krodhanā ca bhairavī lelihānikā / mahāpretā yogamudrā jvālinī kṣobhiṇī dhruvā ityevaṃbahubhedeyaṃ śrīkhecaryeva gīyate / anyāstadaṅgabhūtāstu padmādyā mālinīmate tāsāṃ bahutvāmukhyatvayogābhyāṃ neha varṇanam / śrīkhecarīsamāviṣṭo yadyatsthānaṃ samāśrayet devīsaṃnidhaye tatsyādalaṃ kiṃ ḍambarairvṛthā / kāmye karmaṇi tāśca syurmukhyāḥ kasyāpi jātucit mudrā caturvidhā kāyakaravākcittabhedataḥ tatra pūrṇena rūpeṇa khecarīmeva varṇaye / baddhvā padmāsanaṃ yogī nābhāvakṣeśvaraṃ kṣipet

[tal-a32-v11] Staff-shaped but him should lead until three cavities; having held there, that quickly should drive with three cavities but.

[tal-a32-v12] This having bound in sky movement would be thus in venerable Pūrva-śāsana; sound-light-wind-joined mind having rested and above.

[tal-a32-v13] By this practice-yoga, having pierced Śiva, supreme should go; hands below clavicle having made, left foot and on right.

[tal-a32-v14] Having opened mouth with little fingers, with middle fingers but nose; ring finger wise should crook eyebrow-bend two index fingers.

[tal-a32-v15] Tongue and mantrin should move, hāhā-sound and should cause; with trident by practice, Brahmarandhra present.

[tal-a32-v16] Foot having abandoned, that-only instantly abandons earth; in void-and-nonvoid-dissolution having made, one-staff blue and fire.

[tal-a32-v17] In three-śakti-bound, in three-presiding-deities, trident; should know that by which wise flies in sky.

[tal-a32-v18] Sky-nature having abandoned, being present as existence only; trident equal-taste having made, in taste taste like standing.

[tal-a32-v19] One-staff he having known, trident sky-going, dear; having bound but Khecarī mudrā, having meditated self and Bhairava.

[tal-a32-v20] Khecarī-cakra-joined instantly abandons earth; abandoned-portion, without conduct, without doubt, world-abandoned.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-daṇḍākāraṃ tu taṃ tāvannayedyāvatkakhatrayam / nigṛhya tatra tattūrṇaṃ prerayet khatrayeṇa tu etāṃ baddhvā khe gatiḥ syāditi śrīpūrvaśāsane / dhvanijyotirmarudyuktaṃ cittaṃ viśramya copari anenābhyāsayogena śivaṃ bhittvā paraṃ vrajet / jatrvadhastātkarau kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ ca dakṣiṇe vidāryāsyaṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu nāsikām / anāme kuñcayetprājño bhrūbhaṅgaṃ tarjanīdvayam jihvāṃ ca cālayenmantrī hāhākāraṃ ca kārayet / triśūlena prayogeṇa brahmarandhramupasthitaḥ padaṃ santyajya tanmātraṃ sadyastyajati medinīm / śūnyāśūnyalaye kṛtvā ekadaṇḍe@nilānalau śaktitritayasambaddhe adhiṣṭhātṛtridaivate / triśūlaṃ tadvijānīyādyena vyomotpatedbudhaḥ ākāśabhāvaṃ santyajya sattāmātramupasthitaḥ / śūlaṃ samarasaṃ kṛtvā rase rasa iva sthitaḥ ekadaṇḍaṃ sa vijñāya triśūlaṃ khacaraṃ priye / baddhvā tu khecarīṃ mudrāṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ ca bhairavam khecarīcakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ sadyastyajati medinīm / tyaktāṃśako nirācāro niḥśaṅko lokavarjitaḥ

[tal-a32-v29] This Jvālinī in fire-wheel; by her and hundred-and-eight hundred should recite if; then would succeed three worlds with moving and nonmoving.

[tal-a32-v30] In other bodies self, other from own body; should see moving, from loss and gain standing in coming-going place.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-avadhūto nirācāro nāhamasmīti bhāvayam / mantraikaniṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśyan dehasthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ hlādodvegāsmitākruṣṭanidrāmaithunamatsare / rūpādau vā kartṛkarmakaraṇeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ nāhamasmīti manvāna ekībhūtaṃ vicintayan / karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā siddhyati sphuṭam / vidyāśaṅkī malāśaṅkī śāstraśaṅkī na siddhyati śivo raviḥ śivo vahniḥ paktṛtvātsa purohitaḥ / tatrasthā devatāḥ sarvā dyotayantyo@khilaṃ jagat kaniṣṭhayā vidāryāsyaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ bhruvau tathā / anāme madhyame vaktre jihvayā tālukaṃ spṛśet eṣā karaṅkiṇī devī jvālinīṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam / hanurlalāṭagau hastau prasāryāṅgulitaḥ sphuṭau cālayedvāyuvegena kṛtvāntarbhrukuṭīṃ budhaḥ / vidāryāsyaṃ sajihvaṃ ca hāhākāraṃ tu kārayet eṣā jvālinyagnicakre tayā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam / japedyadi tataḥ siddhyettrailokyaṃ sacarācaram paradeheṣu cātmānaṃ paraṃ cātmaśarīrataḥ / paśyeccarantaṃ hānādādgamāgamapadasthitam

[tal-a32-v32] Kulakuṇḍalinī having bound, within the atom unconscious; left which this in this universe of him intent on withdrawal.

[tal-a32-v33] In own place satisfaction having obtained, consisting of knowledge-nectar-taste; should go to Kanda-abode in middle, sound having made soundless.

[tal-a32-v37] There assembled by pair of wheels unity shines; by reversal but, having thrown twofold-condition, moves thence.

[tal-a32-v38] From thigh to big toe fire of time she should throw; in coming and going movement should move she, marked with liṅga.

[tal-a32-v39] There by union of those conditions grants opening; who knows, he would succeed indeed of reception and emission of sap.

chunks.sanskrit: [and]-navacchidragataṃ caikaṃ nadantaṃ vyāpakaṃ dhruvam / anayā hi khacārī śrīyogasañcāra ucyate kulakuṇḍalikāṃ baddhvā aṇorantaravedinīm / vāmo yo@yaṃ jagatyasmiṃstasya saṃharaṇodyatām svasthāne nirvṛtiṃ labdhvā jñānāmṛtarasātmakam / vrajetkandapadaṃ madhye rāvaṃ kṛtvā hyarāvakam yāvajjīvaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ piṇḍādhāraṃ ca kāmikam / tatra tāṃ bodhayitvā tu gatiṃ buddhvā kramāgatām cakrobhayanibaddhāṃ tu śākhāprāntāvalambinīm / mūlasthānādyathā devi tamogranthiṃ vidārayet vajrākhyāṃ jñānajenaiva tathā śākhobhayāntataḥ / koṇamadhyaviniṣkrāntaṃ liṅgamūlaṃ vibhedayet tatra saṅghaṭṭitaṃ cakrayugmamaikyena bhāsate / vaiparītyāttu nikṣipya dvidhābhāvaṃ vrajatyataḥ ūrvādyaṅguṣṭhakālāgniparyante sā vinikṣipet / gamāgamanasañcāre caretsā liṅgaliṅginī tatra tatpadasaṃyogādunmīlanavidhāyinī / yo jānāti sa siddhyettu rasādānavisargayoḥ sasaṅgamamidaṃ sthānamūrmiṇyunmīlanaṃ param / eṣa kramastato@nyo@pi vyutkramaḥ khecarī parā

[tal-a32-v47] Venerable Vīrāvalī-yoga this would be Khecarī-procedure; by kissing form by mouth, which principle is heard supreme.

[tal-a32-v48] This swallowing universe in moon-sun-pot; by that indeed would be sky-goer thus, venerable Kāmika is called.

[tal-a32-v49] Having released Bhava melt bonds-mudrā indeed śaktis; of principal of them Khecarī she and, by threefold utterance verbal.

[tal-a32-v50] Three-head-mudgara goddess bodily is recited; of them two-eyes and also heart and two breasts indeed and.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yonyādhāreti vikhyātā śūlamūleti śabdyate / varṇāstatra layaṃ yānti hyavarṇe varṇarūpiṇi nādiphāntaṃ samuccārya kauleśaṃ dehasaṃnibham / ākramya prathamaṃ cakraṃ khe yantre pādapīḍitam nādaṃ vai śaktisadgarbhaṃ sadgarbhātkaulinīpadam / bījapañcakacāreṇa śūlabhedakrameṇa tu hṛcchūlagranthibhedaiścidrudraśaktiṃ prabodhayet / vāyucakrāntanilayaṃ bindvākhyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam āgacchellambikāsthānaṃ sūtradvādaśanirgatam / candracakravilomena praviśedbhūtapañjare bhūyastu kurute līlāṃ māyāpañjaravartinīm / punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhṛtiśca khecaryā kriyate budhaiḥ śrīmadvīrāvalīyoga eṣa syātkhecarīvidhiḥ / cumbākāreṇa vaktreṇa yattattvaṃ śrūyate param grasamānamidaṃ viśvaṃ candrārkapuṭasaṃpuṭe / tenaiva syātkhagāmīti śrīmatkāmika ucyate bhavānmuktvā drāvayanti pāśānmudrā hi śaktayaḥ / mukhyāsāṃ khecarī sā ca tridhoccāreṇa vācikī triśiromudgaro devi kāyikī paripaṭhyate / nāsāṃ netradvayaṃ cāpi hṛtstanadvayameva ca

chunks.sanskrit: [and]-vṛṣaṇadvayaliṅgaṃ ca prāpya kāyaṃ gatā tviyam / bhavasthānābhavasthānamuccāreṇāvadhārayet mānasīyamitastvanyāḥ padmādyā aṣṭa mudrikāḥ / mātṛvyūhakule tāḥ syurasyāstu parivāragāḥ śarīraṃ tu samastaṃ yatkūṭākṣarasamākṛti / eṣā mudrā mahāmudrā bhairavasyeti gahvare sūpaviṣṭaḥ padmake tu hastāgrāṅguliraśmibhiḥ / parāṅmukhairjhaṭityudyadraśmibhiḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaiḥ antaḥsthitiḥ khecarīyaṃ saṃkocākhyā śaśāṅkinī / tasmādeva samuttambya bāhū caivāvakuñcitau samyagvyomasu saṃsthānādvyomākhyā khecarī matā / muṣṭidvitayasaṅghaṭṭāddhṛdi sā hṛdayāhvāyā śāntākhyā sā hastayugmamūrdhvādhaḥ sthitamudgatam / samadṛṣṭyāvalokyaṃ ca bahiryojitapāṇikam eṣaiva śaktimudrā cedadhodhāvitapāṇikā / daśānāmaṅgulīnāṃ tu muṣṭibandhādanantaram drākkṣepātkhecarī devī pañcakuṇḍalinī matā / saṃhāramudrā caiṣaiva yadyūrdhvaṃ kṣipyate kila utkrāmaṇī jhagityeva paśūnāṃ pāśakartarī / śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svātmānaṃ pātayanniva

[tal-a32-v62] Called Vīra-Bhairava Khecarī consciousness-increasing; in eight ways thus described in venerable Bhargāṣṭaka-śikhā-kula.

[tal-a32-v63] Thus resorting to many varieties one alone which standing, venerable Khecarī; absorbed by her supreme seed attains.

[tal-a32-v64] One consisting-of-manifestation seed, whose vigor pervading all mantras; one mudrā Khecarī and, multitude of mudrās animated by whom.

[tal-a32-v66] At beginning of sacrifice, in its middle, at its conclusion; in reflection on knowledge and yoga, in cessation of obstacles, in cutting of bonds; of mudrā procedure proper time.

[tal-a32-v68] Thus mudrā-procedure spoken, very secret, which fruit-giving.
